items.title: OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company's culture is 'broken'
items.blurb: David Robinson joins other insiders in urging industry to take more care over rapidly developing technology

items.title: Pizza Bot: Open-Source Inbox for Background AI Agents
items.blurb: A team of developers working at AWS recently open-sourced Pizza Bot, a self-hosted application designed to let AI agents run tasks in the background and return results through an inbox-style interface.

items.title: New Archestra's OpenAPPA Saturates Two Major Security Benchmarks with a 0% Attack Success Rate
items.blurb: Archestra released OpenAPPA, an open-source security engine designed to stop data exfiltration caused by prompt injection or model hallucination.
